BiblicalUsage: The word hâgûwth carries the sense of meditation, musing. In Psalm 49:3, the text says "and the meditation of my heart [shall be] of understanding."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hâgûwth I do not force more than it gives: meditation, musing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
